versions.changelog:
contract-rule-review v2.0.0 introduces major enhancements for automated contract rule review and storage:

- Supports uploading local contract files to AnyShare and invokes the rule review skill automatically.
- Now allows both built-in (API) templates and user-specified custom templates for contract review.
- Generates shareable links for review results.
- Includes detailed setup and configuration instructions for first use, connectivity checks, and troubleshooting.
